racket-langserver.workspaceAnalysis.enab.description: Analyse unopened workspace files for references. Readers and macros run during analysis, as they do for open files. Applies to the bundled language server.

racket-langserver.workspaceAnalysis.excl.description: Directory names excluded from workspace reference analysis and dependency watching. Each name matches a whole path component.

racket-langserver.workspaceAnalysis.maxF.description: Maximum files discovered per workspace analysis pass. Reaching a limit is reported as partial references.
Maximum source file size for background reference analysis.

racket-langserver.workspaceAnalysis.time.description: Time limit for each background file analysis. Timed-out files make the reference index partial. A references or rename request also stops waiting once sources have kept changing for this long with no more files analysed.

racketdap.racketExecutable.description: Full Racket 9.1 or newer installation used by the language server, debugger, REPL, and file commands.

enumDescriptions: Share a plain REPL among files in each workspace folder.
Keep a separate plain REPL for each saved file.
racketdap.repl.sessionScope.description: Choose how Start REPL, Load Current File in REPL and Evaluate Selection in REPL share terminals. Changing this leaves existing sessions available. Unsaved files use the workspace session.

racketdap.languageServer.enabled.description: Enable language tools for Racket and Rhombus. Rhombus requires rhombus-lib in the selected Racket installation. Disable this when another extension supplies the language client.

racketdap.languageServer.source.description: Use the bundled server, or a racket-langserver package already installed for the selected Racket executable.

racketdap.languageServer.startupTimeoutS.description: Maximum seconds allowed for language-server startup, including loading source packages. Increase this for cold startup or a busy machine. Restart and shutdown still cancel startup immediately.

racket-langserver.formatting.documentFor.description: Formatter for whole documents: bundled fixw, or language, which indents by the rules of the file's own language.

racket-langserver.formatting.indentation.description: Indentation formatter for selections and on-type formatting: bundled fixw, or language, which indents by the rules of the file's own language.

racket-langserver.resyntax.enable.description: Enable optional Resyntax suggestions. Requires the separate resyntax Racket package; it is not bundled.

racket-langserver.analysisWaitMillisecon.description: Milliseconds the language server waits after an edit before analysing the document. 0 starts each analysis at once, as the unpatched server does. A change takes effect from the next edit. Applies to the bundled language server.

racketdap.testing.include.description: Workspace-relative glob for Racket test module files. Discovery does not execute modules.

racketdap.testing.exclude.description: Workspace-relative glob for files excluded from Test Explorer.

racketdap.testing.sourceRoots.description: Directories instrumented by Debug Test and Coverage, relative to the workspace folder (absolute paths also work). The test file is always included. Defaults to the whole workspace.

racketdap.debug.packages.description: Installed package names whose sources should be instrumented for debugging, including linked packages outside the workspace. Applies to Debug, Debug Tests, and Debug REPL; restart sessions after changing it.

racketdap.debug.compiledCache.description: Keep instrumented compiled code between debug sessions, in the extension's storage, so a program that has not changed starts without being expanded and compiled again. A hash of each source and of everything it depends on decides what is reused. Like raco make, a macro's output is reused until a file it depends on changes: a macro that reads a file should register it with register-external-file. Applies to new debug sessions.

racketdap.logs.filter.description: Application log capture for new debugger and Interactions sessions. Start with none, fatal, error, warning, info or debug, then optional level@topic overrides, for example: warning debug@network.

racketdap.macroSteps.includeRenamingStep.description: Include scope and identifier-resolution transitions in macro steps.

racketdap.macroSteps.highlightRedexContr.description: Highlight the changed syntax in the Before and After macro panes.

racketdap.macroSteps.drawBindingArrows.description: Draw binding arrows in all open macro panes.

racketdap.macroSteps.oneTermAtATime.description: Show each transformation as a Before position followed by an After position.

racketdap.macroSteps.factorCommonContext.description: Show shared expansion context below paired transformation fragments. Kept while One Term at a Time is enabled.

enumDescriptions: Theme-coloured lock, unlock and zap icons.
Unicode lock, open lock and collision marks.
racketdap.macroSteps.taintIcons.description: Taint marks in macro expansion panes.

program.description: Racket source file to launch. A relative path is relative to `cwd`, or without one to the workspace folder.

racketExecutable.description: Override the Racket executable for this launch.

stopOnEntry.description: Pause automatically at startup, unless this is false. stopOnEntryMode chooses where to pause.

enumDescriptions: Pause in main, the explicitly selected submodule, or the program body when no main exists.
Pause before the first instrumented expression, including initialization in debugged dependencies.
stopOnEntryMode.description: Where to pause when stopOnEntry is true. Ignored when running without debugging.

interactive.description: Keep the module loaded for Debug Console interactions after its entry action finishes.

console.description: Use the integrated terminal for line-oriented program input/output, or Debug Console output with stdin at EOF.

sourceRoots.description: Directories whose Racket sources are debugged. Defaults to the workspace folder.

debugPackages.description: Installed package names to debug. Their source directories are resolved by the launched Racket environment and added to sourceRoots. Defaults to racketdap.debug.packages.

submodule.description: Explicit submodule path, e.g. ["test"]. An empty array loads only the root module. Omit to run main when present.

entry.description: Optional exported zero-argument procedure to call after loading.

languageAdapter.description: Language profile data file for the launch module. Relative paths use cwd, or the workspace folder when cwd is absent.

language.description: Language module for a plain file without #lang, for example racket/base or r5rs. Omit for #lang/module programs.

testMode.description: Run the test submodule when present, otherwise the module body, and report test results. Cannot be combined with interactive, submodule, entry, or language.

logFilter.description: Initial application log capture filter, overriding racketdap.logs.filter. For example: warning debug@network.

debugCache.description: Keep instrumented compiled code between sessions. Defaults to racketdap.debug.compiledCache.

port.description: Loopback listener port supplied by the embedding host.

token.description: Secret authentication token supplied by the host.

racketExecutable.description: Override the Racket executable for the adapter.

sourceRoots.description: Directories whose Racket sources are debugged. Defaults to the workspace folder.

debugPackages.description: Installed package names to debug. Their source directories are resolved by the launched Racket environment and added to sourceRoots. Defaults to racketdap.debug.packages.

action.description: Build a source module or distribute an existing executable.

source.description: Source module for a build, or existing executable for a distribution. Relative to the workspace folder; task variables are supported.

output.description: Executable path or distribution directory, relative to the workspace folder. Task variables are supported.

gui.description: Build a graphical launcher or executable. Distributions inherit their executable's mode.

libraries.description: Additional module paths to embed with raco exe ++lib, for dynamic loading.

languages.description: Additional languages to embed with raco exe ++lang.
